command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

MV=$(multiqc --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $3}')
NEXP=$(awk 'END{print NR}' fastqc_values.tsv)
mkdir -p zips && cp ./*_fastqc.zip zips/

echo "== aggregate the whole cohort =="
multiqc -f -o mqc zips > mq.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 mq.log; exit 1; }
grep -E 'Found [0-9]+ reports' mq.log || true
cp mqc/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt       ./multiqc_fastqc.txt
cp mqc/multiqc_data/multiqc_general_stats.txt ./multiqc_general_stats.txt

echo "== the aggregated table =="
python3 - <<'PY' > mqc_values.tsv
rows=[l.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for l in open('multiqc_fastqc.txt')]
h=rows[0]
i={k:h.index(k) for k in ("Sample","Total Sequences","Sequence length","%GC","total_deduplicated_percentage")}
for r in rows[1:]:
    print('\t'.join(r[i[k]] for k in ("Sample","Total Sequences","Sequence length","%GC","total_deduplicated_percentage")))
PY
sort -o mqc_values.tsv mqc_values.tsv
sort -o fastqc_values.tsv fastqc_values.tsv
paste fastqc_values.tsv mqc_values.tsv

NROW=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' mqc_values.tsv)
test "$NROW" = "$NEXP" || { echo "cohort report has $NROW rows, expected $NEXP -- a sample is missing"; exit 1; }

echo "== NUMERIC comparison: the aggregator must be lossless =="
paste fastqc_values.tsv mqc_values.tsv | awk -F'\t' '{
  if ($6 != $1)      { printf "sample mismatch %s vs %s\n", $1, $6; bad=1 }
  if ($7+0 != $2+0)  { printf "%s total %s vs %s\n", $1, $2, $7; bad=1 }
  if ($8+0 != $3+0)  { printf "%s len %s vs %s\n",   $1, $3, $8; bad=1 }
  if ($9+0 != $4+0)  { printf "%s GC %s vs %s\n",    $1, $4, $9; bad=1 }
  if ($10+0 != $5+0) { printf "%s dedup %s vs %s\n", $1, $5, $10; bad=1 }
} END{ if (bad) exit 1; print "every value round-trips exactly" }'

echo "== conservation: the cohort total the aggregator reports =="
SUMFQ=$(awk -F'\t' '{n+=$2} END{print n}' fastqc_values.tsv)
SUMMQ=$(awk -F'\t' '{n+=$2} END{printf "%d", n}' mqc_values.tsv)
test "$SUMFQ" = "$SUMMQ" || { echo "read totals differ: FastQC $SUMFQ vs MultiQC $SUMMQ"; exit 1; }

echo "== the same comparison done TEXTUALLY, for contrast (observation, not assertion) =="
# NB: awk compares two numeric-looking strings NUMERICALLY, so "1000"=="1000.0" is true.
# Concatenating "" forces the string comparison this observation is actually about.
STRMATCH=$(paste fastqc_values.tsv mqc_values.tsv | awk -F'\t' \
  '($2 "")==($7 "") && ($3 "")==($8 "") && ($4 "")==($9 "") {n++} END{print n+0}')

echo "== a MISSING sample is silent: withhold one and see what the aggregator does =="
mkdir -p partial && cp zips/sampleA_fastqc.zip zips/sampleB_fastqc.zip zips/sampleD_fastqc.zip partial/
set +e
multiqc -f -o mqcp partial > mqp.log 2>&1
PEXIT=$?
set -e
PROW=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{n++} END{print n+0}' mqcp/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt)
PWARN=$(grep -icE 'warn|error' mqcp/multiqc_data/multiqc.log || true)
test "$PEXIT" = "0"    || { echo "multiqc exited $PEXIT with a sample missing -- it is NOT silent after all"; exit 1; }
test "$PROW" = "3"     || { echo "partial cohort has $PROW rows, expected 3"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'MultiQC -- aggregating a cohort, and the two ways that goes wrong quietly\n'
printf 'multiqc_version\t%s\n' "$MV"
printf 'rows_in_report\t%s of %s   (assert equal -- the aggregator must not drop a sample)\n' "$NROW" "$NEXP"
printf 'values_round_trip\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT, numerically, for every sample and metric)\n'
printf 'cohort_reads\tFastQC %s == MultiQC %s   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION across the aggregation)\n' "$SUMFQ" "$SUMMQ"
printf 'string_equal_rows\t%s of %s   (observation: MultiQC writes 1000.0 where FastQC wrote 1000,\n' "$STRMATCH" "$NEXP"
printf 'string_equal_rows\t     so a TEXTUAL comparison of identical numbers disagrees on every row)\n'
printf 'missing_sample_exit\t%s   (assert 0 -- dropping a cohort member is NOT an error to MultiQC)\n' "$PEXIT"
printf 'missing_sample_rows\t%s   (assert 3 -- the report is silently one sample short)\n' "$PROW"
printf 'missing_sample_warnings\t%s   (nothing in the log names the absent sample)\n' "$PWARN"
printf 'note\tan aggregator reports what it FINDS. If one fan-out task failed, or its output never\n'
printf 'note\tlanded, the cohort report is simply smaller and still exits 0 -- so the row count has\n'
printf 'note\tto be asserted against the expected N somewhere outside MultiQC.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
